page.overview:
Who is Nurse Colton?

is a major character in The Man in Room 1280, the third story in Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call. She is a rather serious nurse working in the hospice wing of Heracles Hospital. Nurse Colton can be considered one of the story's antagonists due to her opposition to Arthur and the patient.

Nurse Colton is athletic-looking with brown hair chopped short in a boyish cut, and a great tan.

Nurse Colton is decently nice yet very serious. She considers herself the perfect balance of heart and brain, feeling deeply yet also having a depth of reason. Nurse Colton also believes in the power of intention and human will, which she uses as a nurse to help others.

Nurse Colton's parents died when she was sixteen. Foregoing foster care, she ran away and found a woman who made fake IDs, and got a job on a cruise ship that came with a free roam and board. Over time, she saved up enough money to pay for nursing school, and eventually ended up in Heracles Hospital to use what she knew to help others who lost their parents.
